caption: One host kernel, two ways to use it: the container web runs as a process tree on the host kernel itself with host port 8080 forwarded to port 80 inside, while the KVM guest webvm boots its own kernel on 2 vCPUs with 2048 MB of RAM.

spec.title: Container and KVM guest on one host
spec.aria: From one hardware machine and one host kernel, two paths branch: Docker engine to the container web, which shares the host kernel and maps host port 8080 to port 80; and KVM to the guest webvm, which runs its own kernel with 2 vCPUs and 2048 MB of RAM.
